notes.title: Update V0.2.2.0
notes.content:
We are here with another major update!!!

[b]Gameplay[/b]

Major changes on the gameplay:
[list]
[*] Removed soul drops from defeated enemies.
[*] Permanent Power-ups uses completed levels as currency.
[*] Removed thieves gloves since it was related to collection loot.
[*] Reworked all power-ups and their cost charts.
[*] Changed soul extractor to soul eater.

[/list]

[b]Other[/b]

[list]
[*] Changed enemy damage sfx.
[*] Improved stage objective and minion counter visuals.
[/list]

Gratitude for thy support! [url=https://discord.gg/bDTgmmTuyT][b]Join the cult![/b][/url] Stay tuned for more game updates. 🌟🎮

notes.title: Update V0.2.0.0
notes.content:
I am glad to announce our first ever major update to the Night Feeder!

[b]Gameplay[/b]

Here is the list of things that changed in gameplay
[list]
[*] Added a new minion, Plushie: Fetches Xp.
[*] Fixed difficulty spikes to collect levels later in run.
[*] With the new system you now need to activate the gears around the map to unlock the door.
[/list]

[b]Visuals & UI/UX[/b]

Major changes of this update is the visuals.
[list]
[*] Changed map visuals.
[*] Improved menu hub area visuals.
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated collaborators screen.
[*] Updated how thy plays screen.
[/list]

Hope you like the new visuals of the game, more improvements will come.

Gratitude for thy support! [url=https://discord.gg/bDTgmmTuyT][b]Join the cult![/b][/url] Stay tuned for more game updates. 🌟🎮
